lemma coordinateGraph_adjacency (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (L : Fin 8 × ZMod m ≃ V) (u : V → ℝ) (p : Fin 8 × ZMod m) :
    adjacency (coordinateGraph G L) (u ∘ L) p = adjacency G u (L p)

exact_statements.Nut8.character_formula_of_step:
lemma character_formula_of_step (σ : Equiv.Perm V)
    (L : Fin 8 × ZMod m ≃ V)
    (hL : ∀ i a, L (i,a+1) = σ (L (i,a)))
    (u : V → ℝ) (e : ℝ) (hu : ∀ v, u (σ v) = e * u v) :
    ∀ i b, u (L (i,b)) = e ^ b.val * u (L (i,0))
exact_statements.Nut8.nut_coordinate_character:
theorem nut_coordinate_character [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hn : Nut G)
    (σ : G ≃g G) (hp : (σ.toEquiv : Equiv.Perm V) ^ m = 1)
    (L : Fin 8 × ZMod m ≃ V) (hL : ∀ i a, L (i,a+1) = σ (L (i,a))) :
    ∃ (u : V → ℝ) (ε : ℤ), adjacency G u = 0 ∧ (∀ v, u v ≠ 0) ∧
      (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1 ∧ Even m) ∧ ε ^ m = 1 ∧
      ∀ i b, u (L (i,b)) = (character m ε b : ℝ) * u (L (i,0))

exact_statements.Nut8.adjacency_characterLift:
lemma adjacency_characterLift (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 8 × ZMod m)) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (ht : TranslationInvariant G) (ε : ℤ) (hp : ε ^ m = 1) (v : Fin 8 → ℝ)
    (i : Fin 8) (a : ZMod m) :
    adjacency G (characterLift ε v) (i,a) =
      (character m ε a : ℝ) *
        ((signedQuotient m G ε).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) *ᵥ v) i

exact_statements.Nut8.nut_circulant_quotient:
theorem nut_circulant_quotient [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hn : Nut G) (hc : Circulant 8 G) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : NeZero m) (L : Fin 8 × ZMod m ≃ V) (ε : ℤ),
      (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1 ∧ Even m) ∧ ε ^ m = 1 ∧
      TranslationInvariant (coordinateGraph G L) ∧
      (signedQuotient m (coordinateGraph G L) ε).IsSymm ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (Matrix.mulVecLin
        ((signedQuotient m (coordinateGraph G L) ε).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)))) = 1 ∧
      ∃ v : Fin 8 → ℝ, (∀ i, v i ≠ 0) ∧
        (signedQuotient m (coordinateGraph G L) ε).map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) *ᵥ v = 0

exact_statements.Nut8.principal_minor_ne_zero:
theorem principal_minor_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)
    (hs : A.IsSymm) (hd : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (Matrix.mulVecLin A)) = 1)
    (u : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hu : A *ᵥ u = 0) (hf : ∀ i, u i ≠ 0) (i : Fin (n+1)) :
    (A.submatrix i.succAbove i.succAbove).det ≠ 0
exact_statements.Nut8.full_kernel_det_adjugate:
theorem full_kernel_det_adjugate {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin (n+1)) (Fin (n+1)) ℝ)
    (hs : A.IsSymm) (hd : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (Matrix.mulVecLin A)) = 1)
    (u : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) (hu : A *ᵥ u = 0) (hf : ∀ i, u i ≠ 0) :
    A.det = 0 ∧ ∀ i, A.adjugate i i ≠ 0

theorem nut_circulant_matrix {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hn : Nut G) (hc : Circulant 8 G) :
    ∃ (C : QuotientMatrix) (ε : ℤ), (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) ∧ C.IsSymm ∧

    (u : V → ℝ) (hu : adjacency G u = 0) (hf : ∀ v, u v ≠ 0)

exact_statements.Nut8.neighbor_character_coherent:
theorem neighbor_character_coherent {m : ℕ} [NeZero m]
    (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 8 × ZMod m)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hc : Cubic G)
    (ε : ℤ) (he : ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) (u : (Fin 8 × ZMod m) → ℝ)
    (hu : adjacency G u = 0) (hf : ∀ v, u v ≠ 0)
    (hchar : ∀ i b, u (i,b) = (character m ε b : ℝ) * u (i,0))
    (i j : Fin 8) (b c : ZMod m)
    (hb : G.Adj (i,0) (j,b)) (hc' : G.Adj (i,0) (j,c)) :
    character m ε b = character m ε c
